summary: Runs Python callbacks to construct or process POP points, primitives, vertices, and attributes through CPU-side GeometryStagingData before uploading the result to GPU memory.

key_params.name: callbacks
key_params.note: DAT containing cook(), onPulse(), and setupParameters() callbacks

key_params.name: setuppars
key_params.note: Run setupParameters() to create custom parameters

key_params.name: bypass
key_params.note: Pass the first input through unchanged

key_params.name: freeextragpumem
key_params.note: Release accumulated output GPU memory after geometry shrinks

key_params.name: delinputattrs
key_params.note: Output only attributes explicitly produced by the Script POP

key_concepts: createGeometryStagingData() allocates the CPU-side staging object used to describe geometry.
buildGeometry() allocates output resources and uploads staged points, primitives, vertices, and attributes to the GPU.
cook() builds or processes output whenever the Script POP cooks.
setupParameters() and onPulse() support custom controls on the Script POP.
Input POP data can be read, processed in Python, and emitted as a new POP result.
common_gotchas: Python geometry construction is CPU-side before upload, so bound workload and avoid rebuilding unchanged large geometry every cook.
buildGeometry() clears staging data by default; use forceCopy only when retaining that data is necessary.
Callbacks are case-sensitive and the callbacks DAT must define the expected function signatures.
Repeated output growth and shrinkage can retain extra GPU memory until Free Extra GPU Memory is pulsed.
Delete Input Attributes changes pass-through behavior and can remove attributes downstream nodes expect.
